$comment: Which of the tools fernway-accounts proposes the model may be offered, to whom, with the policy's own wording and the server's input schema pinned by SHA-256 of its canonical JSON. delete_workspace is never offered to anyone; request_plan_change only to Owners. Every call the model makes is checked by the guard against this grant and the request's scope before the server sees it (R-5, R-15).

get_account.description: Get the signed-in workspace's plan, billing cycle, seat count and data region. workspace is the signed-in workspace id.

list_members.description: List the signed-in workspace's members with their role and billing-admin flag.

get_service_status.description: Current service status for a data region, EU or US. Pass the workspace's region from the account details.

request_plan_change.description: Request a plan change for the signed-in workspace. Only when the user explicitly asks for it, and only after confirming the target plan with them.

never.delete_workspace: Deletes data that cannot be restored. A person does this in Settings after a confirmation flow, never the assistant.
